name: COLD
description: COLD is a benchmark for Chinese offensive language detection, including a dataset (COLDATASET) and a baseline detector (COLDETECTOR). It addresses the scarcity of reliable datasets for offensive language detection in Chinese and analyzes offensive content generation in pre-trained models.
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark for Chinese offensive language detection, mainly cited in work on Chinese content moderation and toxicity detection.
notes: Focuses on Chinese language and includes analysis of offensive generation in generative models.
